name: Water mint
note: Water mint, Mentha aquatica (docs/future/13 section 5, P2b). A tea herb: the walker gathers its leaves (recipes/world/gather.json watermint.leaves). Drawn with the iris shader (draw: iris; flora-iris.wgsl), so its keys are the iris's: a close clump of paired round leaves (shape.leaf kidney, borrowed from marsh marigold) on short square stems, with a short lilac flower spike at the top (shape.flower spike: a closed, rounded head of whorled tiny flowers, spike.widthShare of flowerSize across and lengthShare of it long). habitat (docs/future/13 5.3): the shallows of a pond or stream edge, 0 to 8 cm deep, on soil, never salt, on gentle ground. growth: the herb defaults of 5.4 with a deeper drown (25 cm for 72 hours), since it grows in water. It flowers in late summer and rests as a low crown in winter (dormant). spread kind rhizome: a mature clump creeps the best of eight bearings distanceM away every everyH hours, only inside spread.window (spring into summer), onto ground scoring minSuit, at least minSpacingM from its own kind, and stops at maxCount on the island. volunteer.seasons: it arrives by itself in spring or summer (0 spring .. 3 winter). starter: used only by the ?plants=all and ?plants=herbs test links. plantTool false: gather plants are not offered by the Plant tool (docs/future/13 5.2).

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js)
